biography.value:
蜥蜴人是一種原始的爬行類類人生物，它們潛伏在世界的沼澤與叢林中。其狩獵小村分佈在各處環境惡劣的坑洞，半沉的廢墟，以及水中洞窟裏茁壯成長。

護國仇外者Territorial Xenophobes。蜥蜴人很少與外族進行交易買賣。它們在自己的領土裏動用迷彩斥候來保護領地。發現不速之客時，部族會委派一支狩獵小隊前去騷擾或驅趕非法侵入者，或是將對方誤導如鱷魚和其他危險生物的巢穴裏。
蜥蜴人沒有傳統的道德觀念，它們認爲善惡完全是外來的概念。它們是真正絕對中立的生物，只是在權宜之時它們仍會實行殺戮，並不惜一切代價生存下去。
蜥蜴人很少在它們的狩獵區外遊蕩。任何進入其領土的生物都會作爲狩獵的一部分而被跟蹤、殺害進而成爲食物。類人生物、野獸和怪物在蜥蜴人眼中毫無差別。而蜥蜴人也不喜歡離開自己領地邊境過於遙遠，以避免成爲被獵殺的對象而不是狩獵者。
蜥蜴人有時會與鄰居結盟。這些蜥蜴人通常會直接發現人類、矮人、半身人和精靈都值得信任並且對自己有所幫助。而這些與外界建立聯繫的蜥蜴人也可以迅速成爲對方堅定有力的盟友。

盛宴和犧牲Great Feasts and Sacrifices。雜食的蜥蜴人也有喫類人生物血肉的習性。其俘虜通常會被帶回到營地中，然後被用作藉口舉辦盛大的宴會，或是包含羣舞、演說和打鬥娛樂的社羣儀式。這些受害者要麼被部族作爲食物煮食，要麼被獻祭給蜥蜴人之神塞繆安亞Semuanya。

精明手作者Canny Crafter。儘管蜥蜴人並不是技藝高超的工匠，但它們會用在殺戮中取得的骨頭製作工具和裝飾性的珠寶，還會使用死去怪物的獸皮和貝殼來製作盾牌。

蜥蜴人領袖Lizardfolk Leaders。蜥蜴人以宗教的形式警衛魔法。它們由薩滿領導部族，負責主持儀式並祭拜塞繆安亞。但有時蜥蜴人部族也會離開塞繆安亞，轉而接觸另一個強大的形象塞斯伊奈克Sess'inek，一個意圖腐化並控制蜥蜴人的爬行類惡魔領主。
以塞斯伊奈克的形象出生的蜥蜴人會比其他的蜥蜴體型更大，並且徹底屬於邪惡一方。這些蜥蜴會作爲國王或皇后統治蜥蜴人部族並篡奪薩滿的權威，激發其子民們不尋常的攻擊行爲。

巨龍信徒Dragon Worshiper。蜥蜴人說龍語，而它們自認是由遠古時代的巨龍所傳授。在巨龍領地以內棲息的蜥蜴人部族通常會給龍獻上貢品以贏得對方的青睞。而邪惡的龍類也會利用蜥蜴人來達成其邪惡目的，並將其變成襲擊者和掠奪者。

Lizardfolk are primitive reptilian humanoids that lurk in the swamps and jungles of the world. Their hut villages thrive in forbidding grottos, half-sunken ruins, and watery caverns.

Territorial Xenophobes. Lizardfolk deal and trade with other races only rarely. Fiercely territorial, they use camouflaged scouts to guard the perimeter of their domain. When unwelcome visitors are detected, a tribe sends a hunting band to harass or drive the trespassers off, or tricks them into blundering into the lairs of crocodiles and other dangerous creatures.

Lizardfolk have no notion of traditional morality, and they find the concepts of good and evil utterly alien. Truly neutral creatures, they kill when it is expedient and do whatever it takes to survive.

Lizardfolk rarely stray beyond their claimed hunting grounds. Any creature that enters their territory is fair game to be stalked, killed, and devoured. They make no distinction between humanoids, beasts, and monsters. Similarly, lizardfolk don't like reaching too far beyond their borders, where they could easily become the hunted instead of the hunters.

Occasions might arise when lizardfolk will form alliances with their neighbors. These lizardfolk usually learn firsthand that humans, dwarves, halflings, and elves can sometimes prove helpful or trustworthy. Once lizardfolk forge ties with outsiders, they are steadfast and fierce allies.

Great Feasts and Sacrifices. Lizardfolk are omnivorous, but they have a taste for humanoid flesh. Prisoners are often taken back to their camps to become the centerpieces of great feasts and rites involving dancing, storytelling, and ritual combat.

Victims are either cooked and eaten by the tribe, or are sacrificed to Semuanya, the lizardfolk god.

Canny Crafters. Though they aren't skilled artisans, lizardfolk craft tools and ornamental jewelry out of the bones of their kills, and they use the hides and shells of dead monsters to create shields.

Lizardfolk Leaders. Lizardfolk respect and fear magic with a religious awe. Lizardfolk shamans lead their tribes, overseeing rites and ceremonies performed to honor Semuanya. From time to time, however, a lizardfolk tribe produces a powerful figure touched not by Semuanya but by Sess'inek-a reptilian demon lord who seeks to corrupt and control the lizardfolk.

Lizardfolk born in Sess'inek's image are larger and more cunning than other lizardfolk, and are thoroughly evil. These lizard kings and queens dominate lizardfolk tribes, usurping a shaman's authority and inspiring uncharacteristic aggression among their subjects.

Dragon Worshipers. Lizardfolk speak Draconic, which they are thought to have learned from dragons in ancient times. A tribe that wanders into the territory of a dragon will offer it tribute to win its favor. An evil dragon might exploit lizardfolk for its own vile ends, turning them into raiders and plunderers.

“我每次與蜥蜴人打交道都不知道它們在想什麼。它們的爬行動物眼睛總是讓人捉摸不透。我給它們帶去補給物。而它們卻給我帶來驚嚇。”

某商人講起他在蜥蜴沼澤與蜥蜴人部族相遇時的經歷如是說

“In all my dealings with the lizardfolk, I was never able to tell what they were thinking. Their reptilian eyes belied no hint of their intentions. I gave them supplies. They gave me the willies.”

— A merchant's account of his experience with the lizardfolk tribes of the Lizard Marsh

items.name: 多重攻擊（僅蜥蜴人形態）Multiattack (Lizardfolk Form Only)

description.value:
蜥蜴人發動兩次攻擊：一次啃咬攻擊和一次爪擊攻擊。

The lizardfolk makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

近戰武器攻擊：命中+4，觸及5尺，單一目標。命中：5（1d6+2）點穿刺傷害，或鱷魚形態時7（1d10+2）點穿刺傷害。如果蜥蜴人處於鱷魚形態且目標是一大型或更小體型生物，則該目標被擒抱（逃脫DC 12）。直至該擒抱效應終止前，該目標受束縛，且該蜥蜴人無法再啃咬其他目標。如果該蜥蜴人恢復其真實形態，則該擒抱效應終止。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 ([[/damage 1d6 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage, or 7 ([[/damage 1d10 + 2 type=piercing]]) damage in @creature[crocodile] form. If the lizardfolk is in crocodile form and the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target is &Reference[condition=grappled] (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is &Reference[condition=restrained], and the lizardfolk can't bite another target. If the lizardfolk reverts to its true form, the grapple ends.

items.name: 爪擊（僅蜥蜴人形態）Claws (Lizardfolk Form Only)

description.value:
近戰武器攻擊：命中+4，觸及5尺，單一目標。命中：4（1d4+2）點揮砍傷害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 ([[/damage 1d4 + 2 type=slashing]]) damage.

蜥蜴人以魔法化身爲一隻鱷魚，並維持該形態1小時。它可以用一個附贈動作恢復其真實形態。變形時它將保留除體型外所有的資料。其身上着裝或攜帶的所有裝備將維持原樣。蜥蜴人死亡時將恢復其真實形態。

The lizardfolk magically polymorphs into a @creature[crocodile], remaining in that form for up to 1 hour. It can revert to its true form as a bonus action. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range:

  • You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round.
  • You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom.
  • You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, a puff of wind, the sound of a small animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot cube.
  • You instantly light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or if you cast it again.

You can also attack with the flame, although doing so ends the spell. When you cast this spell, or as an action on a later turn, you can hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes [[/damage 1d8 type=fire]] damage.

This spell's damage increases by [[/damage 1d8]] when you reach 5th level ([[/damage 2d8]]), 11th level ([[/damage 3d8]]), and 17th level ([[/damage 4d8]]).

You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes [[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]] damage, and if the creature is Large or smaller, you pull the creature up to 10 feet closer to you.

This spell's damage increases by [[/damage 1d6]] when you reach 5th level ([[/damage 2d6]]), 11th level ([[/damage 3d6]]), and 17th level ([[/damage 4d6]]).

materials.value: the stem of a plant with thorns

description.value:
Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain}.

A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be &Reference[condition=restrained] by the entangling plants until the spell ends. A creature &Reference[condition=restrained] by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

When the spell ends, the conjured plants wilt away.

effects.name: Entangle
effects.description: A creature in the area is Restrained by the entangling Plants until the spell ends. A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

description.value:
You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is &Reference[rule=heavilyobscured]{heavily obscured}. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes [[/damage 2d8 type=fire]] damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your subsequent turns to cause this damage again.

If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage from it, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it doesn't drop the object, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by [[/damage 1d8]] for each slot level above 2nd.

materials.value: a piece of iron and a flame

description.value:
The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes &Reference[rule=difficultterrain]{difficult terrain} for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes [[/damage 2d4 type=piercing]] damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area at the time the spell is cast must make a Wisdom (&Reference[skill=Perception]) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

materials.value: seven sharp thorns or seven small twigs, each sharpened to a point

description.value:
You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears:

  • One beast of challenge rating 2 or lower
  • Two beasts of challenge rating 1 or lower
  • Four beasts of challenge rating 1/2 or lower
  • Eight beasts of challenge rating 1/4 or lower

Each beast is also considered fey, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.

The DM has the creatures' statistics.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, you choose one of the summoning options above, and more creatures appear: twice as many with a 5th-level slot, three times as many with a 7th-level slot, and four times as many with a 9th-level slot.

This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two possible uses for the spell, granting either immediate or long-term benefits.

If you cast this spell using 1 action, choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot radius centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.

You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected.

If you cast this spell over 8 hours, you enrich the land. All plants in a half-mile radius centered on a point within range become enriched for 1 year. The plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested.

items.name: 施法（僅蜥蜴人形態）Spellcasting (Lizardfolk Form Only)

description.value:
蜥蜴人作爲5級施法者，其施法屬性爲感知（法術豁免DC 12，法術攻擊命中+4）。蜥蜴人準備了下列德魯伊法術：

戲法（隨意）：@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.Q6muyDarRcXMcuKv]{德魯伊伎倆 Druidcraft}，@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.axyaTwbdF8zn6BYi]{燃火術 Produce Flame}，@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.xdcwYwrogiY6Rvng]{荊棘之鞭 Thorn Whip}

1環（4法術位）：@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.NZ4JOGBMJzeCKT5O]{糾纏術 Entangle}，@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.rKLSWNBCS8eqGUll]{雲霧術 Fog Cloud}

2環（3法術位）：@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.tf3EIMrOkbZvOxSz]{灼熱金屬 Heat Metal}，@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.1oL8DBOVZMuhaKpw]{荊棘叢生 Spike Growth}

3環（2法術位）：@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.JTNL68CjsZelE8b5]{動物咒喚術 Conjure Animals}（僅爬行類），
@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack-zh-tw.new-icon.Item.1TP8dARdcRojx7P1]{植物滋長 Plant Growth}

Spellcasting (Lizardfolk Form Only). The lizardfolk is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, [[/r 1d20+4]]{+4} to hit with spell attacks). The lizardfolk has the following druid spells prepared:

  • Cantrips (at will): @UUID[.MwmMp971kcIIyvwf], @UUID[.hWhS4WFY2FA9j15r], @UUID[.xfDBGXR5UbJjHayA]

  • 1st level (4 slots): @UUID[.bfzA4QfcogtOP1YS], @UUID[.1hFjS08DdB4Ypvpg]

  • 2nd level (3 slots): @UUID[.JWWs9HsMrJWPZita], @UUID[.PhPG2Cru88eTqdvS]

  • 3rd level (2 slots): @UUID[.HTmfb6jPtnsOMNxk] (reptiles only), @UUID[.ReQYVz5e9vV4ZKAC]

蜥蜴人可以憋氣15分鐘。

The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
